questions: What must happen if Registry randomly mints, after a clean mapping was shown, an id equal to an id in the kept import file?

judgement.divergence: After production randomly mints an imported id, rebuilding the mapping requires refusal, while the second passage asserts that confirmation can find no such new conflict.

consequences: Without one of these rules, a clean shown mapping can become conflicting before confirmation.
